- GoToColor(RED=1) points toward the RED nest wall = toward nest
- GoToColor(BLUE=3) or GoToColor(GREEN=2) points toward source walls

1. On BLACK floor (source): item acquired → immediately head to nest (GoToColor RED)
2. On WHITE floor (nest): item delivered → immediately head back to source

- State 0: GoToColor(BLUE/GREEN) [go to source], transition on BLACK floor → State 1
- State 1: GoToColor(RED) [go to nest], transition on WHITE floor → State 0
